assign.outcome:
**ext/Panel did not sprawl in the direction you think — 3,807 lines, and the flex/grid words are two hardcoded CSS declarations.**

[**proposal.md**](/framework/ai/2026-08-18/panel-complexity/proposal.md) — the map (20 rows, sums to `wc`), keep/park/delete/merge, the three variants, the panel-flow recorder, the ordered strategy.

| verdict | lines | what |
|---|---|---|
| KEEP | ~2,380 | class, doors, sizing, grip, edge split, drag, focus, `generate.js`, the bar |
| PARK | 647 | `text.js` + `persist.js` + `repeat.js` — page *editing*, not layout *exploring*; two words (`TEXT.on=false`, `REPEAT.on=false`) park them today |
| DELETE | ~300 | the align overlay (dead by your own word), `insert.js` (the 5th of 6 ways to add a panel), `zoom_scrub` (demo's magnifier, re-lifted), `scatter` as the default seed |
| MERGE | 311 | `toolbar.js` + `properties.js` draw the same six word-sets twice — one `WORDS` table, two hosts |

**The three findings that matter.** (1) `display.css` is the whole flex/grid vocabulary: flex is always a row with a 0.5em gap, grid always `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(8em,1fr))` — no gap, wrap, justify, align-items, track count, auto-fill, span or areas is reachable from any control. (2) Responsive is absent from Panel and already built in `ext/demo/stage.js`; `zoom_scrub` and `coalesce()` both admit they were lifted from it. (3) The nine preconfigured layouts already exist as spec strings in [`space/presets.js`](/framework/styles/layouts/space/) and `structure()` already translates spec text — a text door beside its seed door is ~10 lines.

**No variant is a class.** Stage = `demo.stage(() => panel(seed))`; full-screen page-as-panel already ships as the [`/full/`](/framework/ext/Panel/full/) route; mini-app host is one `T` entry drawing `demo.app(tree)`. Panel-flow: snapshot `root.toJSON()` on the root Item's `change/add/remove` — ~25 lines, build it third, after the words it would otherwise record wrongly.

**Left deliberately:** no code changed (read-only judge task). The sibling test-drives ([panel-flex](/framework/ai/2026-08-18/panel-flex/), [panel-grid](/framework/ai/2026-08-18/panel-grid/)) had logged no findings at write time and were not waited on — their results should be checked against step 1 before it is built.
